input.goal: Deliver four independent fixes: (1) security — reject shootout creation when chain or DI track is not owned by the current user; (2) wiring — serve the missing GET /library/chains/group page using the already-built Jinja2 template; (3) feature — PATCH comment editing endpoint plus HTMX inline edit UI; (4) cleanup — remove dead is_system_track references from backend context builder and frontend templates.

observable_truths.statement: A user visiting GET /library/chains/group?id=<uuid> sees a page showing the group name, description, and slot configuration rendered by the Jinja2 template.

Submitting the shootout creation form with a signal chain not owned by the current user receives a 404 response and no shootout is created.
Submitting the shootout creation form with signal chains and a DI track all owned by the current user succeeds and redirects to the new shootout page.
